title: Pixel Tracking Event
description: Closed AdCP event vocabulary for renderer-fired pixel trackers. Impression and viewability values through `viewable_video_50` map to IAB OpenRTB Native event tracker types 1-4. `audible_video_complete` is an AdCP-defined first-class event, not an assigned IAB Native event type; Native reserves 500+ for exchange-specific use. `click` represents Native click trackers and `custom` is the explicit adopter-defined extension point.
